| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timeout` | `30` | Request timeout. |
| `retries` | `5` | Retry count. |

The `fetch(timeout=30)` function performs a request.
The `timeout` (default: 30) is measured in seconds.
The default timeout is 30 seconds.
The default retries is 5.
By default, requests time out after 30 seconds.
The project supports Python 3.9+.
The `HTTP_PROXY` environment variable configures the proxy.
